import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    a = list(map(int, data[1:n+1]))
    k = int(data[n+1])
    
    a.sort()
    
    max_count = 1
    for i in range(n):
        count = 1
        j = i + 1
        while j < n and a[j] - a[i] <= k:
            count += 1
            j += 1
        if count > max_count:
            max_count = count
    
    print(max_count)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
